scope: Fresh Nix lock and storage snapshots, then bounded noninteractive privileged wait-state, FD and kernel-stack reads restricted to revalidated current Nix lock owners
constraints: No shared-process signals or process control
No Nix execution or acceptance rerun
No deletion, daemon restart or host configuration change
No product source, dependency/toolchain pin or historical evidence change
Do not infer lifecycle completion from diagnosis
privilege: Use noninteractive sudo only after current PID, process start identity and exact held-lock identity are verified; record and stop privileged inspection if unavailable
